why: Six combat takes were Mixamo bench clips carried over from the source project. The user asked for the motion set to be replaced. Higgsfield's 3d_rigging job returns a rigged GLB with a baked action from an indexed library; animation_action_id is an opaque integer with no enum, so the library was mapped by sampling ids and reading back what came out.

libraryProbe.method: generate 3d_rigging on one uploaded mesh, read the action name out of the returned GLB in Blender (8 credits per probe)
libraryProbe.finding: combat clusters around 190-260; 1-100 is locomotion and gesture

conversion.noBoneRename: MEASURED via Assets/Editor/ClipAvatarProbe.cs: the generated rig is Mixamo-named (LeftUpLeg/LeftForeArm/Spine02/lower-case neck) and Unity's humanoid auto-mapper accepts it untouched - isHuman True, 15/15 required bones, against a shipped Mixamo clip as control. A 22-entry BONE_MAP was written, measured to be dead code, and deleted.
conversion.noRootMotionStrip: ReimportClips already sets lockRootRotation/lockRootHeightY/lockRootPositionXZ (CharacterImportPipeline.cs:314-319). Stripping in Blender would duplicate Unity's in-place projection and risk disagreeing.
conversion.sceneRangeFix: A plain glb->fbx convert produced a 10.38 s clip from a 2.23 s action: Blender's DEFAULT scene range 1-250 was exported, not the action. The script now reads first/last keyframe off the fcurves. Not a trim - the 0.8-frame key spacing is a 30 fps source read at 24 fps and is correct.

trims.poseWindow: 5 frames @12fps = 0.4167 s = 10 frames at the clips' 24 fps

critical.note: 86.7% of Thrust Slash is windup; untrimmed it clamps to MaxPoseSpeed 4x and still shows only the windup

untrimmed.bighit: preamble 23.8% vs displaced 5.3% - worse, but a reaction that plays at its authored pace, not squeezed into a pose window

driftFixed: ClipWindowProbe and ClipTrimFitTests each carried their own copy of the clip table and kept measuring displaced takes after the swap - the trim test read the OLD attack window as live. Both now read CharacterImportPipeline.ClipFileAt so the table is the single source.
verification: EditMode 874/874. Trim row mutation-proved: 13..23 -> 16..28 turns TrimRowsLandInsideTheirSourceClips RED.
